tools.name: AudioCraft
tools.author: facebookresearch
tools.description: Meta's framework for audio generation. MusicGen (text→music), AudioGen (text→sound effects), EnCodec (neural codec). Single repo, production-ready.
tools.longDescription: AudioCraft is a PyTorch library for deep learning research on audio generation. It bundles three models: **MusicGen** for conditional music generation (text or melody), **AudioGen** for environmental sound generation from text, and **EnCodec**, a high-fidelity neural audio codec. The whole stack runs on a single GPU and is the same code Meta uses in production for their stem-splitting and music-gen demos.

tools.name: Whisper
tools.author: openai
tools.description: OpenAI's general-purpose speech recognition. 99 languages, robust to accents and noise, available in 5 model sizes (tiny → large-v3).
tools.longDescription: Whisper is a transformer-based speech-to-text model trained on 680,000 hours of multilingual audio. Five model sizes from `tiny` (39M params, real-time on CPU) to `large-v3` (1.5B params, near-human accuracy). Includes built-in translation, language ID, and timestamp generation. Works on any audio format; ffmpeg handles decoding.

tools.name: Bark
tools.author: suno-ai
tools.description: Suno's transformer-based text-to-audio. Generates highly realistic multilingual speech, music, sound effects, and non-verbal communication (laughs, sighs).
tools.longDescription: Bark is a fully generative text-to-audio model. Unlike typical TTS, it can produce laughter, sighs, music, and sound effects in addition to speech. Supports 13+ languages out of the box and 100+ speaker presets. Runs on a single GPU; the small checkpoint fits in 4 GB VRAM.

tools.name: Demucs
tools.author: facebookresearch
tools.description: Meta's hybrid Transformer/Demux audio source separation. Splits any song into vocals, drums, bass, and other. v4 is the current SOTA.
tools.longDescription: Demucs v4 is Meta's state-of-the-art music source separation model. Given a mixed song, it produces up to 4 stems (vocals, drums, bass, other) with quality that beats every open baseline. Includes the `htdemucs` hybrid transformer architecture, a 6-stem variant (adds piano and guitar), and the `mdx` quantizer-based branch for fast inference. Works on any audio length; segment-shifts between chunks.

tools.name: MusicGen Melody
tools.author: facebookresearch
tools.description: Text + reference melody → music. Generate music that follows a hummed or sung melody. Up to 30 seconds in one shot.
tools.longDescription: MusicGen Melody is the melody-conditioned variant of MusicGen. Give it a text prompt *and* a reference audio (hum, sing, or any melody), and it generates a full mix that follows the reference melody. Supports continuation from a seed clip. The HF demo shows the same control surface as the production tool.

tools.name: Riffusion
tools.author: riffusion
tools.description: Stable Diffusion fine-tuned on spectrograms. Real-time text-to-music with interpolation between prompts.
tools.longDescription: Riffusion is a Stable Diffusion 1.5 model fine-tuned on 32×32 mel-spectrograms of music. Inference is real-time on a single GPU and supports prompt interpolation (smoothly blend between two text prompts in latent space). Includes a web app, an interactive interpolation slider, and a CLI.

tools.name: Stable Audio
tools.author: stabilityai
tools.description: Stability AI's latent diffusion model for variable-length stereo audio. Beats closed-source models on most metrics.
tools.longDescription: Stable Audio is a latent diffusion transformer trained on 800k+ licensed music tracks. Generates up to 90 seconds of variable-length stereo audio at 44.1 kHz from a text prompt. The open `stable-audio-open` weights are permissively licensed and run on consumer GPUs. The commercial API and `stable-audio-2` are gated.

tools.name: XTTS v2
tools.author: coqui-ai
tools.description: Coqui's TTS with zero-shot voice cloning from a 6-second sample. 17 languages, streaming, low latency.
tools.longDescription: XTTS v2 is Coqui's flagship multilingual TTS. Clones any voice from a 6-second reference clip and supports 17 languages. Includes a streaming mode for low-latency real-time use, a voice mixing API, and emotion/style control. The HF demo shows the full control surface; deployment via `gradio deploy`.

tools.name: Ultimate Vocal Remover
tools.author: Anjok07
tools.description: Best open-source vocal remover. Wraps MDX-Net and Demucs with a Gradio UI. Used by YouTubers, remixers, and karaoke makers worldwide.
tools.longDescription: UVR bundles the best open-source source-separation models (MDX-Net, Demucs, VR Arch) behind a polished Gradio interface. Supports batch processing, multiple output formats, stem selection, and post-processing (de-reverb, de-echo). The HF Space is the same code; the GitHub release adds the desktop UI.

tools.name: Real-Time Voice Cloning
tools.author: CorentinJ
tools.description: Clone a voice from 5 seconds of audio and synthesize speech in real time. SV2TTS + WaveRNN, the architecture behind the 'real-time TTS' viral demos.
tools.longDescription: CorentinJ's Real-Time Voice Cloning Toolbox implements Google's SV2TTS paper (encoder + synthesizer + vocoder) with real-time inference. Train a speaker embedding from 5 seconds of audio, then synthesize arbitrary text in that voice with sub-200ms latency. Includes a Gradio UI, pre-trained checkpoints, and a CLI.

tools.name: so-vits-svc-fork
tools.author: 34j
tools.description: Soft-VC singing voice conversion fork. Train a model on 10+ minutes of clean vocals, then convert any input to that voice.
tools.longDescription: so-vits-svc-fork is the most actively maintained fork of the popular soft-vc-svc project. Train a model on 10+ minutes of clean, isolated vocals, then convert any singing or speech into that voice. Includes F0-based pitch shifting, speaker mixing, a real-time inference script, and a Gradio UI.

tools.name: MMAudio V2
tools.author: hkchengrex
tools.description: Add synchronized audio to silent video. Generates SFX, ambience, and music that match the visual content. Trained on 1.5M video clips.
tools.longDescription: MMAudio V2 takes a silent video and a text prompt and produces synchronized audio (SFX, ambience, music) that matches the visual action. Trained on 1.5M video clips with dense audio-visual alignment. Supports up to 8-second outputs at 48 kHz stereo. The HF demo includes a video uploader and a prompt input.

tools.name: CogVideoX
tools.author: THUDM
tools.description: Tsinghua's open text-to-video and image-to-video diffusion model. Up to 10-second 720p clips on a single GPU.
tools.longDescription: CogVideoX is Tsinghua's open text-to-video and image-to-video model. The 5B variant generates 6-second 720p clips at 16 fps in ~90 seconds on an A100; the 2B variant runs on a 4090. Includes prompt expansion via a built-in LLM, video extension, and an image-conditioning mode for img2video.

tools.name: LTX-Video
tools.author: Lightricks
tools.description: Lightricks' DiT-based video model. Real-time 30 fps generation at 720×1280. The fastest open video gen in 2026.
tools.longDescription: LTX-Video is Lightricks' diffusion transformer for video. Generates 30 fps 720p video *faster than realtime* on a single H100 or 4090. Supports text-to-video, image-to-video, video extension, and keyframe interpolation. The HF Space ships with a prompt enhancer and a one-click gallery.

tools.name: Wan 2.1
tools.author: Wan-AI
tools.description: Alibaba's open video foundation model. 14B parameters, text-to-video and image-to-video, supports 480p and 720p outputs up to 5 seconds.
tools.longDescription: Wan 2.1 is Alibaba's open video foundation model. The 14B variant generates 5-second 720p video at 24 fps with strong prompt adherence and motion coherence. The 1.3B variant runs on 8 GB VRAM. Supports both text-to-video and image-to-video, with a T2V-1.3B checkpoint that fits on a 4090.

tools.name: HunyuanVideo
tools.author: Tencent
tools.description: Tencent's 13B parameter video foundation model. 5-second 720p output with cinematic camera motion and prompt-faithful content.
tools.longDescription: HunyuanVideo is Tencent's open video foundation model. 13B parameters, single-stage training, supports text-to-video up to 5 seconds at 720p. Includes a built-in prompt rewriter, an image-conditioning branch (i2v), and a video extension mode. Strong on camera motion and human subjects.

tools.name: VideoCrafter
tools.author: VideoCrafter
tools.description: Open text-to-video and image-to-video. Up to 2K resolution, supports long video generation, controllable camera motion.
tools.longDescription: VideoCrafter is an open-source video generation toolbox. Supports text-to-video, image-to-video, video editing, and controllable camera motion. The latest release adds long video generation (up to 16 seconds via sliding-window) and a frame interpolation mode. Apache 2.0.

tools.name: AnimateDiff
tools.author: guoyww
tools.description: Turn any Stable Diffusion checkpoint into a video generator with a single adapter. No retraining needed.
tools.longDescription: AnimateDiff is a motion-module adapter that plugs into any Stable Diffusion text-to-image checkpoint to add video generation. No fine-tuning required. The HF Spaces ecosystem includes dozens of AnimateDiff variants (lightning, LCM, v3, XL, SVD) — pick the one that matches your base checkpoint.

tools.name: Moondream
tools.author: vikhyatk
tools.description: 1.8B parameter visual language model. Real-time image and video understanding. Runs on CPU, 1 GB VRAM, or mobile.
tools.longDescription: Moondream is a 1.8B parameter VLM that handles image captioning, visual question answering, object detection, and short-video understanding. The smallest variant runs on CPU at ~1 fps; the full model needs 1 GB VRAM. Great for adding 'what's in this video' to any Gradio pipeline.

tools.name: Basic Pitch
tools.author: spotify
tools.description: Spotify's lightweight polyphonic audio-to-MIDI transcriber. CNN+GRU, runs in real time, handles polyphonic audio up to 6 notes.
tools.longDescription: Basic Pitch is Spotify's open-source polyphonic audio-to-MIDI model. Handles up to 6 simultaneous notes with reasonable accuracy, runs in real time on CPU, and exports standard MIDI files. Includes a pitch-bend detector and a note-on confidence score. The HF Space includes a batch mode and a visualization.

tools.name: RVC WebUI
tools.author: RVC-Project
tools.description: Retrieval-based Voice Conversion. The most popular open-source voice conversion project. Trains a model on 10 minutes of clean audio.
tools.longDescription: RVC (Retrieval-based Voice Conversion) is the most popular open-source voice conversion project. Train a model on 10 minutes of clean audio, then convert any voice to that target. Includes a Gradio WebUI, a real-time inference mode, a training pipeline, and a model index for sharing checkpoints.

tools.name: GPT-SoVITS
tools.author: RVC-Boss
tools.description: Few-shot voice cloning + TTS. 5 seconds of reference audio is enough. Supports Chinese, English, and Japanese out of the box.
tools.longDescription: GPT-SoVITS combines a GPT-style autoregressive decoder with the SoVITS acoustic model. Few-shot voice cloning from 5 seconds of reference audio, supports Chinese/English/Japanese, and runs in real time on a 6 GB GPU. Includes a WebUI, a training pipeline, and a built-in UVR5 vocal extraction step.

tools.name: Tortoise TTS
tools.author: neonbjb
tools.description: Strong multi-voice TTS with high realism. Trades speed for quality — runs at 2x realtime on GPU.
tools.longDescription: Tortoise TTS is a multi-voice TTS optimized for realism over speed. Uses a decoder-only transformer with a UnivNet vocoder, autoregressive decoding at 2x realtime on a 4090. Supports voice cloning from a short reference clip and emotion/style control via prompt prefix.

tools.name: AudioLDM 2
tools.author: haoheliu
tools.description: Text-to-audio + text-to-music + text-to-sound-effects in one model. Latent diffusion, real-time on a 4090.
tools.longDescription: AudioLDM 2 is a unified latent diffusion model for text-to-audio, text-to-music, and text-to-sound-effects. Uses a shared audio tokenizer and a GPT-style language model to condition the decoder. Real-time inference on a 4090, supports up to 30-second outputs, includes a Gradio UI and a CLI.
